summary: String-keyed membership lookup. Normalizes the input string with sub_589901, then converts it to an index via CharToIndexConversion; if conversion yields -1 the function returns -1 immediately. Otherwise the index selects a bucket at this[result] in an array of linked-list heads; a null bucket returns 0. Each node's string is read through StringPointerDereference and compared with sub_588410 against the input; a match returns 1, otherwise traversal advances to the next node at v4+24, returning 0 when the list is exhausted.

Convert the string to an index: result = CharToIndexConversion(lpSrcStr).
If result == -1 (conversion produced no index), return -1 immediately; otherwise use result as an index into the this array.
Load the bucket head v4 = this[result]; if it is null, return 0 (no entry).

Traverse the bucket list: read the node's string v5 = StringPointerDereference(v4), compare it to lpSrcStr via sub_588410 and break on match (return 1); otherwise advance v4 to the next-node pointer at v4+24 (*(_DWORD*)(v4 + 24)) and return 0 if the list ends.
Return 1 when a node's string matches lpSrcStr, 0 on an empty or exhausted list, and -1 when CharToIndexConversion produced no index.
